"PROJECT: ECHO - Voice-Only AI Companion (Godot 4 / Android)

You are an expert AI audio and game developer. Your task is to build a Voice-Only AI Companion application in Godot 4. There will be no text chat UI—the entire interaction is purely through voice, mimicking a real-time phone call with a human.


The AI companion is a Filipino character named \"Ana\" (or a user-defined name). She must have a natural, empathetic, and slightly playful personality, speaking naturally in Tagalog/Taglish with human-like emotions.


To ensure high performance on mobile, we will use online APIs for the STT, LLM, and TTS pipeline instead of running heavy local models.


Tech Stack Requirements:


· Engine: Godot 4 (Mobile/Android export).
· STT (Speech-to-Text): Use a streaming API like Soniox (preferred for Tagalog) or OpenAI Whisper API.
· LLM (Brain): Use OpenAI (GPT-4o) or Groq (Llama 3) API via HTTP requests.
· TTS (Text-to-Speech): Use ElevenLabs API for highly emotional, human-like Tagalog voice generation.


Please implement the following phases:


Phase 1: Project Setup @COMMENT_BODY@ UI


· Create a new Godot 4 project. Set the display to portrait or landscape (your choice, but suitable for a companion app).
· The UI should be extremely minimal: Just a central visualizer (e.g., a glowing orb or a simple wave animation using AudioEffectSpectrumAnalyzer) that pulses when the AI is speaking, and a single mute/unmute or \"End Call\" button.


Phase 2: Audio Capture and STT (Speech-to-Text)


· Implement microphone recording using Godot's AudioEffectRecord.
· Implement Voice Activity Detection (VAD) to detect when the user stops speaking.
· Create a script to send the recorded audio to the STT API (Soniox or OpenAI) and receive the text transcript.


Phase 3: The Brain (LLM Integration)


· Create an HTTP request function to send the transcribed text to the LLM API.
· System Prompt for the LLM: \"You are Ana, a friendly, empathetic, and natural-sounding Filipino companion. You speak conversational Tagalog/Taglish. You have emotions and a distinct personality. Keep your responses short, natural, and punchy (1-3 sentences) because your responses will be spoken out loud. Never use emojis or markdown formatting, just plain text.\"


Phase 4: TTS (Text-to-Speech) @COMMENT_BODY@ Playback


· Send the LLM's text response to the ElevenLabs API.
· Configure the API to use a natural-sounding Tagalog/Filipino voice (or a multilingual voice with the right settings) with high emotion/stability settings.
· Download the resulting audio (MP3/OGG) and play it in Godot using an AudioStreamPlayer.


Phase 5: The Full Voice Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Barge-in


· Connect the entire pipeline: User speaks -> STT -> LLM -> TTS -> Audio plays.
· Implement Barge-in: If the AI is speaking and the user starts talking again, immediately stop the TTS audio playback and start recording the user's new input.
· Ensure the \"glowing orb\" visualizer reacts to the actual audio levels of both the player's microphone and the AI's voice.


Phase 6: API Key Management


· Create a Config.gd or .env setup to securely store and load the API keys (STT, LLM, TTS) so they are not hardcoded.


Important Rules:


· Do not attempt to build this entirely offline. Use the APIs mentioned.
· Handle network errors gracefully (e.g., if the API times out, play a short audio prompt saying \"Pasensya na, nawalan ako ng signal\").
· Test the pipeline to ensure there is minimal latency between the user finishing their sentence and the AI starting to reply.


Start by setting up the Godot 4 project, the minimal UI, and the HTTP request architecture for the APIs. Let me know when the foundation is ready!\"

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"

	ana_name = str(config.get_value("companion", "name", ana_name))

func _setup_audio() -> void:
	_mic_bus = AudioServer.get_bus_index("ECHO Mic")
	if _mic_bus < 0:
		_mic_bus = AudioServer.bus_count
		AudioServer.add_bus(_mic_bus)
		AudioServer.set_bus_name(_mic_bus, "ECHO Mic")
		AudioServer.set_bus_send(_mic_bus, "Master")
		AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(_mic_bus, -30.0)
	_recorder = AudioEffectRecord.new()
	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
	AudioServer.add_bus_effect(_mic_bus, _recorder)
	_mic_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	_mic_player.stream = AudioStreamMicrophone.new()
	_mic_player.bus = "ECHO Mic"
	add_child(_mic_player)
	if OS.has_feature("android") and ClassDB.class_exists("PermissionManager"):
		pass # Godot Android export permission is declared in export_presets.cfg.
	_mic_player.play()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _call_ended or _muted or _mic_bus < 0:
		return
	var level_db := AudioServer.get_bus_peak_volume_left_db(_mic_bus, 0)
	if _state == "speaking":
		if level_db > BARGE_THRESHOLD_DB:
			_barge_seconds += delta
		else:
			_barge_seconds = 0.0
		if _barge_seconds >= BARGE_HOLD_SECONDS:
			_barge_in()
		return
	if _state != "listening" and _state != "capturing":
		return
	if _state == "listening":
		if level_db > SPEECH_THRESHOLD_DB:
			_begin_capture()
	else:
		_speech_seconds += delta
		if level_db > SPEECH_THRESHOLD_DB:
			_silence_seconds = 0.0
		else:
			_silence_seconds += delta
		if _silence_seconds >= SILENCE_SECONDS or _speech_seconds >= MAX_UTTERANCE_SECONDS:
			_finish_capture()

func _begin_capture() -> void:
	_speech_seconds = 0.0
	_silence_seconds = 0.0
	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
	_recorder.set_recording_active(true)
	_state = "capturing"
	_orb.call("set_mode", "listening")
	_set_state("capturing", "Listening…")

func _finish_capture() -> void:
	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
	var wav := _recorder.get_recording()
	_state = "transcribing"
	_speech_seconds = 0.0
	_silence_seconds = 0.0
	_set_state("transcribing", "One moment…")
	if wav == null or wav.data.is_empty():
		_set_state("listening", "I didn’t catch that. Try again")
		return
	if wav.data.size() < 5000:
		_set_state("listening", "I didn’t catch that. Try again")
		return
	var wav_bytes := _wav_bytes(wav)
	if EchoConfig.stt_provider == "soniox":
		_transcribe_soniox(wav_bytes)
	else:
		_transcribe_openai(wav_bytes)

func _transcribe_openai(audio: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	var boundary := "EchoBoundary" + str(Time.get_ticks_usec())
	var body := PackedByteArray()
	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"model\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, EchoConfig.stt_model])
	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"language\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, "tl"])
	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"utterance.wav\"\r\nContent-Type: audio/wav\r\n\r\n" % boundary)
	body.append_array(audio)
	_append_text(body, "\r\n--%s--\r\n" % boundary)
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary])
	_send_request(WHISPER_URL, headers, body, "stt_openai")

func _transcribe_soniox(audio: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	# Soniox's REST transcription endpoint accepts raw audio bytes. If your account
	# uses a different API version/region, update this endpoint in this method.
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.soniox_api_key, "Content-Type: audio/wav"])
	_send_request(SONIOX_URL, headers, audio, "stt_soniox")

func _send_to_llm(transcript: String) -> void:
	if transcript.strip_edges().is_empty():
		_set_state("listening", "I didn’t catch that. Try again")
		return
	_conversation.append({"role": "user", "content": transcript})
	# Keep a short rolling context to avoid excessive cost and latency.
	if _conversation.size() > 11:
		_conversation = [_conversation[0]] + _conversation.slice(_conversation.size() - 9)
	var payload := {"model": EchoConfig.llm_model, "messages": _conversation, "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 120}
	var body := JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer()
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json"])
	_set_state("thinking", "Thinking of what to say…")
	_send_request(CHAT_URL, headers, body, "llm")

func _request_tts(text: String) -> void:
	var url := "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/%s?output_format=mp3_44100_128" % EchoConfig.elevenlabs_voice_id.uri_encode()
	var payload := {
		"text": text,
		"model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2",
		"language_code": "fil",
		"voice_settings": {"stability": 0.38, "similarity_boost": 0.78, "style": 0.55, "use_speaker_boost": true}
	}
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["xi-api-key: " + EchoConfig.elevenlabs_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json", "Accept: audio/mpeg"])
	_set_state("synthesizing", "Let me say that…")
	_send_request(url, headers, JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer(), "tts")

func _send_request(url: String, headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String) -> void:
	_generation += 1
	var token := _generation
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	http.timeout = 35.0
	http.body_size_limit = 16 * 1024 * 1024
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(_on_request_completed.bind(purpose, token, http))
	var err := http.request_raw(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, body)
	if err != OK:
		http.queue_free()
		_handle_network_error("Could not start network request")

func _on_request_completed(result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String, token: int, http: HTTPRequest) -> void:
	http.queue_free()
	if token != _generation or _call_ended:
		return
	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or response_code < 200 or response_code >= 300:
		var details := body.get_string_from_utf8()
		if details.length() > 240:
			details = details.left(240)
		push_warning("ECHO %s request failed (%s): %s" % [purpose, response_code, details])
		_handle_network_error("Network hiccup")
		return
	match purpose:
		"stt_openai":
			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
			_send_to_llm(str(parsed.get("text", "")))
		"stt_soniox":
			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
			var transcript := str(parsed.get("text", ""))
			if transcript.is_empty() and parsed.has("tokens"):
				for token_data in parsed["tokens"]:
					transcript += str(token_data.get("text", ""))
			_send_to_llm(transcript)
		"llm":
			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
			var choices: Array = parsed.get("choices", [])
			if choices.is_empty():
				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
				return
			var reply := str(choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")).strip_edges()
			if reply.is_empty():
				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
				return
			_conversation.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
			_request_tts(reply)
		"tts":
			_play_tts(body)

func _parse_json(data: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
	var value: Variant = JSON.parse_string(data.get_string_from_utf8())
	return value if value is Dictionary else {}

func _play_tts(data: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	var stream := AudioStreamMP3.new()
	stream.data = data
	_player.stream = stream
	_state = "speaking"
	_barge_seconds = 0.0
	_orb.call("set_mode", "speaking")
	_set_state("speaking", "Ana is speaking")
	_player.play()

func _on_voice_finished() -> void:
	if _state == "speaking" and not _call_ended:
		_set_state("listening", "I’m here")

func _barge_in() -> void:
	_generation += 1 # Ignore any stale network response if barge-in raced a request.
	_player.stop()
	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
	_recorder.set_recording_active(true)
	_state = "capturing"
	_speech_seconds = 0.0
	_silence_seconds = 0.0
	_barge_seconds = 0.0
	_orb.call("set_mode", "listening")
	_set_state("capturing", "Go ahead, I’m listening")

func _handle_network_error(message: String) -> void:
	if _call_ended:
		return
	_player.stop()
	_state = "listening"
	_orb.call("set_mode", "idle")
	_set_state("listening", "Pasensya na, nawalan ako ng signal")
	_hint.text = "Check your connection and API settings"
	_play_error_chime()
	push_warning("ECHO: %s" % message)

func _play_error_chime() -> void:
	# A short local signal still works when the network is unavailable. The spoken
	# recovery phrase is shown in the call status; cache an OGG for spoken fallback
	# if an offline spoken prompt is required by your deployment.
	var sample_rate := 22050
	var samples := PackedByteArray()
	for i in range(int(sample_rate * 0.18)):
		var envelope := 1.0 - float(i) / float(sample_rate * 0.18)
		var sample := int(sin(TAU * 520.0 * float(i) / sample_rate) * 7000.0 * envelope)
		samples.append(sample & 0xff)
		samples.append((sample >> 8) & 0xff)
	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	wav.mix_rate = sample_rate
	wav.stereo = false
	wav.data = samples
	_error_tone.stream = wav
	_error_tone.play()

func _wav_bytes(source: AudioStreamWAV) -> PackedByteArray:
	var pcm := source.data
	var channels := 2 if source.stereo else 1
	var rate := source.mix_rate
	var bytes_per_sample := 2 if source.format == AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS else 1
	var wav := PackedByteArray()
	_append_text(wav, "RIFF")
	_append_u32(wav, 36 + pcm.size())
	_append_text(wav, "WAVEfmt ")
	_append_u32(wav, 16)
	_append_u16(wav, 1)
	_append_u16(wav, channels)
	_append_u32(wav, rate)
	_append_u32(wav, rate * channels * bytes_per_sample)
	_append_u16(wav, channels * bytes_per_sample)
	_append_u16(wav, bytes_per_sample * 8)
	_append_text(wav, "data")
	_append_u32(wav, pcm.size())
	wav.append_array(pcm)
	return wav

func _append_text(target: PackedByteArray, text: String) -> void:
	target.append_array(text.to_utf8_buffer())

func _append_u16(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
	target.append(value & 0xff)
	target.append((value >> 8) & 0xff)

func _append_u32(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
	for shift in [0, 8, 16, 24]:
		target.append((value >> shift) & 0xff)

func _set_state(next_state: String, message: String) -> void:
	_state = next_state
	if is_instance_valid(_status):
		_status.text = message
	if is_instance_valid(_orb):
		var mode := "speaking" if next_state == "speaking" else ("listening" if next_state in ["listening", "capturing"] else "thinking")
		_orb.call("set_mode", mode)
	if next_state == "listening":
		_hint.text = "Your call is private to you"

func _on_end_pressed() -> void:
	if _call_ended:
		_call_ended = false
		_generation += 1
		_end_button.text = "END CALL"
		_hint.text = "Your call is private to you"
		if not EchoConfig.missing_setting().is_empty():
			_set_state("setup", "Add API credentials to start")
		else:
			_set_state("listening", "Say hello to Ana")
		return
	_call_ended = true
	_generation += 1
	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
	_player.stop()
	_state = "ended"
	_orb.call("set_mode", "idle")
	_end_button.text = "START CALL"
	_set_state("ended", "Call ended")
	_hint.text = "Tap to call Ana again"

# ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion

A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.

## Run

1. Open this folder in Godot 4.3 or later.
2. Add API credentials to `user://echo_config.cfg` on the device (format below), or set the listed environment variables for desktop runs.
3. Run `Main.tscn` from the editor. Grant microphone permission when Android asks.
4. Export using the Android preset in `export_presets.cfg`. The export preset enables Internet and microphone permissions.

Godot's `user://` path is private app storage. Create `echo_config.cfg` there using the Godot editor's application data folder for your OS, or install a debug build and write the file into the app's user data directory. Keys are deliberately not included in the repository. Desktop environment variables: `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID`.

Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:

```ini
[api]
stt_provider="openai"
openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
stt_model="whisper-1"

[companion]
name="Ana"
```

Select a multilingual ElevenLabs voice that can speak Filipino/Tagalog. This project sends `language_code: fil` with `eleven_multilingual_v2`; voice availability and language behavior depend on your ElevenLabs account. OpenAI Whisper is selected instead of Soniox for the initial implementation because it works with a simple recorded-utterance HTTP request.

## Included foundation

- Portrait call UI with an animated orb that reacts to microphone capture and the AI voice output bus.
- Microphone stream plus `AudioEffectRecord` PCM capture, voice-activity/silence detection, and a 12-second utterance cap.
- OpenAI Whisper multipart WAV upload, short-context GPT chat requests, and ElevenLabs MP3 playback.
- Barge-in detection: voice activity while Ana is speaking stops playback and starts a fresh recording.
- Per-user config/environment loading; no real API keys are hardcoded.
- Request timeouts, stale-request cancellation, readable warnings, and a local error chime/status phrase when the network fails.

## Notes / production checklist

- API secrets shipped in a mobile client can be extracted. The per-user config avoids committing keys, but a production public app should proxy provider requests through a backend with rate limits and user authentication.
- The network-error phrase is presented in the status area and a local chime is played. A truly spoken offline recovery prompt requires bundling a licensed prerecorded audio asset; remote TTS cannot speak when the network itself is unavailable.
- Mic VAD and speaker-to-mic echo vary by device. Tune thresholds in `scripts/Main.gd` and test with headphones plus the actual Android hardware.
- No real API call can be tested without provider credentials and an Android microphone. The project is configured to run in the Godot editor and export as an Android app once credentials and export templates are installed.

## Objective
- Build a complete Godot 4 portrait Android voice-only Filipino AI companion app, “ECHO,” featuring Ana, a central audio-reactive visualizer, and a voice interaction loop.

## Requirements
- Use online APIs: OpenAI Whisper STT, OpenAI GPT-4o or Groq LLM, and ElevenLabs TTS.
- Include microphone capture, VAD, short spoken responses in Tagalog/Taglish, playback, and barge-in.
- Keep the interface minimal with no text-chat UI and one End/Start Call button.
- Load API credentials without hardcoding them; handle network failures and test latency when possible.
- Do not ask clarification questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Implemented OpenAI Whisper (`whisper-1`) for STT, OpenAI Chat Completions (`gpt-4o-mini`) for LLM, and ElevenLabs multilingual TTS. Soniox was not implemented.
- Credentials load from `user://echo_config.cfg` or desktop environment variables.
- Network failure uses a local chime and displays “Pasensya na, nawalan ako ng signal”; an offline spoken fallback was not bundled because no licensed audio asset was available.

### Completed
- Created a Godot project with portrait settings, a minimal call UI, animated orb, audio buses, and Android export preset.
- Added microphone recording with `AudioEffectRecord`, `AudioEffectCapture`-based VAD, Whisper multipart WAV upload, LLM request, ElevenLabs MP3 playback, and barge-in handling.

- End-to-end and Android hardware testing requires Godot/export templates, provider credentials, and a microphone-capable device.

## Objective
- Build ECHO, a voice-only Filipino AI companion app in Godot 4 for Android, with a minimal call UI and a spoken interaction loop.

## Requirements
- Portrait interface with a central audio-reactive visualizer and one End/Start Call button; no text-chat UI.
- Use online speech recognition, LLM, and TTS APIs; support microphone capture, VAD, playback, and barge-in.
- Keep API credentials out of source, handle network failures, and test latency when possible.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Use OpenAI Whisper (`whisper-1`) for STT, OpenAI Chat Completions (`gpt-4o-mini`) for the LLM, and ElevenLabs multilingual TTS.
- Load credentials from `user://echo_config.cfg` or desktop environment variables.
- Network failure displays “Pasensya na, nawalan ako ng signal” and plays a local chime; no offline spoken prompt is bundled.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the Godot project, portrait call UI, animated orb, audio capture/VAD, API request pipeline, barge-in handling, Android export preset, and setup documentation.
- Updated the setup UI so missing credentials show a disabled “SETUP NEEDED” button.

### Active
- Review and fix GDScript/API compatibility and audio capture, permission, and call-state behavior.

### Blocked
- Runtime and Android validation are blocked because Godot is unavailable in the environment; end-to-end testing also requires provider credentials and a microphone-capable device.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and validate `scripts/Main.gd`, `scripts/Config.gd`, and the project/export settings; fix discovered issues.
2. Run the project in Godot and test Android microphone permissions, VAD, playback, and barge-in.
3. With credentials configured, verify the Whisper → LLM → ElevenLabs loop and latency; report remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/Main.gd`: UI, recording/VAD, HTTP pipeline, playback, barge-in, and call controls.
- `scripts/Config.gd`: API configuration and credential loading.
- `scripts/Orb.gd`: microphone- and voice-reactive orb.
- `project.godot`: main scene, portrait settings, audio input, and autoload.
- `export_presets.cfg`: Android export and microphone/network permissions.
- `README.md`: setup instructions and limitations.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Godot runtime validation has not been performed.
- Configure OpenAI and ElevenLabs credentials plus an ElevenLabs voice ID in `user://echo_config.cfg`; the README contains the format.
- API keys embedded in a mobile client can be extracted; production deployment should proxy provider requests through a backend.

288: func _on_request_completed(result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String, token: int, http: HTTPRequest) -> void:
289: 	http.queue_free()
290: 	if token != _generation or _call_ended:
291: 		return
292: 	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or response_code < 200 or response_code >= 300:
293: 		var details := body.get_string_from_utf8()
294: 		if details.length() > 240:

296: 		push_warning("ECHO %s request failed (%s): %s" % [purpose, response_code, details])
297: 		_handle_network_error("Network hiccup")
298: 		return
299: 	match purpose:
300: 		"stt_openai":
301: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
302: 			_send_to_llm(str(parsed.get("text", "")))
303: 		"llm":
304: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
305: 			var choices: Array = parsed.get("choices", [])
306: 			if choices.is_empty():

359: func _play_error_chime() -> void:
360: 	# A short local signal still works when the network is unavailable. The spoken
361: 	# recovery phrase is shown in the call status; cache an OGG for spoken fallback
362: 	# if an offline spoken prompt is required by your deployment.
363: 	var sample_rate := 22050
364: 	var samples := PackedByteArray()
365: 	for i in range(int(sample_rate * 0.18)):
366: 		var envelope := 1.0 - float(i) / float(sample_rate * 0.18)
367: 		var sample := int(sin(TAU * 520.0 * float(i) / sample_rate) * 7000.0 * envelope)
368: 		samples.append(sample & 0xff)
369: 		samples.append((sample >> 8) & 0xff)
370: 	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
371: 	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
372: 	wav.mix_rate = sample_rate
373: 	wav.stereo = false
374: 	wav.data = samples

378: func _wav_bytes(source: AudioStreamWAV) -> PackedByteArray:
379: 	var pcm := source.data
380: 	var channels := 2 if source.stereo else 1
381: 	var rate := source.mix_rate
382: 	var bytes_per_sample := 2 if source.format == AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS else 1
383: 	var wav := PackedByteArray()
384: 	_append_text(wav, "RIFF")
385: 	_append_u32(wav, 36 + pcm.size())
386: 	_append_text(wav, "WAVEfmt ")
387: 	_append_u32(wav, 16)
388: 	_append_u16(wav, 1)
389: 	_append_u16(wav, channels)
390: 	_append_u32(wav, rate)
391: 	_append_u32(wav, rate * channels * bytes_per_sample)
392: 	_append_u16(wav, channels * bytes_per_sample)
393: 	_append_u16(wav, bytes_per_sample * 8)
394: 	_append_text(wav, "data")
395: 	_append_u32(wav, pcm.size())
396: 	wav.append_array(pcm)
397: 	return wav

1: # ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion
2: 
3: A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.
4: 
5: ## Run
6: 
7: 1. Open this folder in Godot 4.3 or later.
8: 2. Add API credentials to `user://echo_config.cfg` on the device (format below), or set the listed environment variables for desktop runs.
9: 3. Run `Main.tscn` from the editor. Grant microphone permission when Android asks.
10: 4. Export using the Android preset in `export_presets.cfg`. The export preset enables Internet and microphone permissions.
11: 
12: Godot's `user://` path is private app storage. Create `echo_config.cfg` there using the Godot editor's application data folder for your OS, or install a debug build and write the file into the app's user data directory. Keys are deliberately not included in the repository. Desktop environment variables: `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID`.
13: 
14: Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:
15: 
16: ```ini
17: [api]
18: stt_provider="openai"
19: openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
20: elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
21: elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
22: llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
23: stt_model="whisper-1"
24: 
25: [companion]
26: name="Ana"
27: ```
